name: Tough Love
overview: Scripture teaches that true love involves both grace and discipline, reflecting God's own example of sacrificial love in giving His Son for our salvation. While believers are called to love one another and fulfill the law through love, they must also bear personal responsibility and accept correction, as chastening produces righteousness and peace. This balance of mercy and firmness is grounded in treating others with the respect and fairness we desire, without harsh judgment, embodying a tough love that leads to spiritual growth.
